question: Which attributes are held in the elephant-trunk hand and the right hand?
premises: A sweet ball is assigned as an attribute
The sweet ball is held in the elephant-trunk hand
A goad is held in the right hand
inference: The image holds a modaka in the trunk-hand and an aṅkuśa in the right hand.
plain_english: He holds a modaka in his trunk-hand and a goad in his right hand.
